noLectureHint: Open a recording in Toledo to download it or control it with the keyboard.
siteOffTitle: Velox is off on this site
siteOffHint: Turn it on to use the shortcuts and downloads here.
enableNote: Only this site. You can remove it again in Settings.
errNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errEncrypted: This recording is encrypted and can't be downloaded.
errFmp4: This recording's format can't be downloaded yet.
errNoStream: No lecture has been found on this page yet.
errNoBackground: Velox isn't responding. Reload the page and try again.
errSafari: Downloads aren't supported in Safari yet.
errNotStarted: The browser didn't start the download.
sheetFooter: Change these in Velox's settings · Esc to close
enabledDesc: Turn off to use the player without Velox's shortcuts and extras.
languageDesc: For Velox's menu, settings and on-screen messages.
skipDesc: How far the skip shortcuts jump.
speedStepsDesc: How much faster or slower each press makes it (0.25× – 4×).
rememberSpeedDesc: New lectures start at the speed you last chose.
rememberSpeedDescNow: New lectures start at the speed you last chose (now {speed}).
resumeDesc: Reopening a lecture jumps back to where you stopped.
shortcutsIntro: Click a key to change it, or + to add a second one. While recording, Esc cancels and Backspace removes the key. Press ? on a lecture to see them all.
recordingAria: Recording. Press a key, or Esc to cancel.
reservedKey: {key} can't be used: it's needed to move around the page.
movedKey: {key} was used for “{from}”. It now does “{to}”.
sitesIntro: Velox always works on Toledo and on Kaltura video players. To use it somewhere else, open that site and choose Enable in the Velox menu.
aboutText: Velox is an independent, open-source student project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by KU Leuven. It collects no data. Downloaded recordings are for your personal study only: don't share them.
welcomeIntro: Better controls for your lecture recordings. Three things to know:
welcomeStep1: The shortcuts work right away. No need to click in the player first.
welcomeStep2: ← → skip, Space pauses, [ ] change the speed, 0–9 jump through the lecture.
welcomeStep3: Click the puzzle-piece icon next to the address bar and pin Velox. Its menu lets you download the lecture, change the speed and open the settings.
sequoIntro: Sequo tracks which lectures you still have to catch up on. Open the settings in Sequo and choose Link with Velox. Watched lectures, your position and downloads then reach Sequo by themselves. Without a link, nothing goes to Sequo.
sequoAsk: Sequo at {site} asks to link. That page then gets which recordings you watched, your position and the names of your downloads. Only link if this is your address.
sequoLinked: Linked with {site}. Watched lectures, your position and downloads reach Sequo as soon as you open it.
sequoDenied: Not linked: the browser didn't get permission.
downloadsToVerbatimDesc: Saves recordings in Downloads/Verbatim/<course code>/, where Verbatim picks them up. Without a course code, a download stays in Downloads. PDF and PPTX files on Toledo get a button that saves them to the same folder.
themeDesc: Light, dark or like your system. The overlay on the player stays dark.
slideSaved: In course folder {code}. Tap to save again
slideFailed: Couldn't save. Are you still logged in? Tap to try again
